mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing starts signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the industrial production signal.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous 3 months signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in demand during a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the demand contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% combined with an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening supply and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 2% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.
